title: Counter-Selector Wave 35: real-world handoff proof-component join audit
purpose: Apply the executable Wave 34 handoff contract to three real public transitions, preserve each genuine proof component, and refuse to assemble a complete handoff from components belonging to different systems, packages, recipients, and transitions.

complete_real_world_handoff_requires: one identified package and transition binds every proof component
the outgoing and incoming roles are attributable on that same package
integrity covers package contents rather than only a role or abstract root
authority, credentials, dependencies, access, open decisions, and deadlines are inventoried
rollback, refusal, emergency, conflict, and safe-decline behavior are established
the recipient acknowledges the exact identified package
the recipient or successor operates from that package without hidden predecessor state
independent review can inspect the same package, acknowledgment, and resulting operation

controls.public_label: portable IO FAT package with executable round-trip and unresolved safety defects
controls.system_or_subject: ARSAS IO List FAT portable handover

source_records.title: Persist IO FAT progress and export portable handover packages
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines the portable package, local persistence, import, export, safety claims, regression coverage, and stated remaining work.

source_records.title: IO Test project persistence service
source_records.artifact_scope: Implements versioned snapshot and package formats, manifests, hashes, atomic writes, evidence import, report export, and cross-workspace restoration.

source_records.title: IO Test persistence regression tests
source_records.artifact_scope: Tests local restoration, partial-continuity downgrade, portable package round-trip, printable report inclusion, and tampered snapshot rejection.

source_records.title: Codex review threads on ARSAS portable handover
source_records.artifact_scope: Preserves four unresolved findings: cross-workbook evidence mixing, stale snapshot overwrite, missing aggregate decompression budget, and null required manifest members.

components.versioned_package_identity: ARSAS-IOFAT-PACKAGE-1.0 with manifest, snapshot, source workbook, evidence journals, printable report, and README
components.exact_integrity_binding: manifest SHA-256 checks plus evidence hash-chain verification and a tampered-snapshot rejection test
components.outgoing_and_incoming_identity_or_role: exporter and importer software roles are present; no named human outgoing and incoming package participants are bound
components.authority_and_credential_ledger: export is blocked during an active IED session; no complete authority, credential, or environment-access ledger is attached
components.dependency_and_access_inventory: application, workbook, evidence, and local-root surfaces are represented; total archive expansion and all environment dependencies are not bounded
components.open_decision_and_deadline_inventory: completed and incomplete test state is preserved, but no complete package-level open-decision and deadline inventory is acknowledged
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_conflict_handl: atomic writes, evidence collision preservation, continuity downgrade, and tamper rejection exist; stale snapshot overwrite and evidence-scope defects remain
components.package_level_recipient_acknowledgment: automated import success exists; no named recipient acknowledges one exact package and its contents
components.successor_operation_from_package_state: automated round-trip restores progress under different local roots and emits a portable report
components.independent_verification: one external automated review exists and preserves four unresolved findings rather than clearing the package

positive_findings: A versioned portable package with explicit entries is implemented rather than merely documented.
The regression suite executes a package export/import round-trip across distinct workspace roots.
Tampered snapshot bytes are rejected and partial ON continuity is downgraded to REVIEW after session loss.
Atomic file replacement and evidence-journal hash verification create bounded integrity and recovery surfaces.
known_review_findings: Evidence journals are scoped only by ProjectId, allowing different workbook hashes to mix during export.
Import can overwrite a newer local snapshot with an older package snapshot without comparison, prompt, or backup.
Per-entry and archive-count limits do not establish an aggregate uncompressed-size budget.
Missing or null required manifest strings can escape the documented import-failure path.
falsifiers: the four external review findings are resolved in merged code and regression tests
a named recipient acknowledges the exact package digest and entry inventory
a recipient operates the package in an independently observed field environment
package conflict and rollback behavior preserve newer local state under every import ordering
aggregate archive expansion is bounded before disk writes

controls.public_label: two-party cryptographic acceptance of a handover binding without complete package verification
controls.system_or_subject: Cargo OS PDS Proof of Handover

source_records.title: Require both Proof of Handover participant signatures
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines fixed outgoing and incoming signer roles, trusted Ed25519 signatures over the exact binding root, failure conditions, and the remaining independent-package-verification increment.

source_records.title: Proof of Handover signature implementation
source_records.artifact_scope: Implements fixed role checks, participant identity matching, trust-store lookup, key validity and revocation checks, domain-separated payloads, and Ed25519 verification.

source_records.title: Proof of Handover signature tests
source_records.artifact_scope: Exercises valid two-party acceptance and rejects missing incoming signatures, role substitution, revoked keys, and unauthorized delegated signers.

components.versioned_package_identity: a deterministic handover binding root is identified; the complete portable package is not independently verified in this increment
components.exact_integrity_binding: both fixed participant roles sign the same domain-separated binding root with trusted Ed25519 keys
components.outgoing_and_incoming_identity_or_role: outgoing and incoming Participant identities are explicit and signer identity must equal ParticipantID
components.authority_and_credential_ledger: trust-store key identity, algorithm, validity interval, revocation, and nondelegated signer authority are checked
components.dependency_and_access_inventory: the signed binding joins transfer, audit lineage, evidence bundle, policy, and verification-certificate roots; operational package dependencies are not independently inspected
components.open_decision_and_deadline_inventory: not established for the complete portable package
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_conflict_handl: missing signatures, role substitution, revoked keys, invalid timing, and unauthorized delegation fail closed
components.package_level_recipient_acknowledgment: incoming signature acknowledges the binding root, not an independently verified complete package inventory
components.independent_verification: the PR explicitly retains independent complete-package verification as a separate increment

positive_findings: Outgoing and incoming participant roles are fixed rather than inferred from an unordered signature collection.
Both sides sign the exact same deterministic root with trusted keys.
Identity, algorithm, key validity, revocation, timing, and binding-root checks fail closed.
The implementation refuses delegated signing until an explicit authorization registry exists.
known_review_findings: The source itself classifies FM-29 as partial because independent verification of the complete portable handover package remains separate.
falsifiers: the signed root is shown not to bind the claimed transfer and evidence lineage
the incoming signature is accepted without the incoming Participant role
a revoked or unauthorized key is accepted
the complete portable package is independently verified against the same signed root
a successor operates from the verified package without hidden predecessor state

controls.public_label: customer independently operates a product after written guidance without an operational package receipt

source_records.title: BasketForm-AI customer handover document
source_records.artifact_scope: States deployment, known limitations, independent-use status, customer confirmation, and post-course support expectations.

source_records.title: Week 7 final meeting transcript
source_records.artifact_scope: Records the customer independently uploading two videos, observing updated results and chart state, confirming operation, and discussing API-key and server-maintenance expectations.

components.versioned_package_identity: no single versioned outgoing operational package or digest is identified
components.exact_integrity_binding: no package manifest or package-level integrity receipt is observed
components.outgoing_and_incoming_identity_or_role: team and customer roles are visible in the transition record
components.authority_and_credential_ledger: the customer is advised to create an OpenRouter account and API key and maintain server hosting; no credential-transfer or authority-completion receipt is observed
components.dependency_and_access_inventory: repository documentation and some operating expectations are described; complete runtime, account, backup, and ownership state is not acknowledged as one package
components.open_decision_and_deadline_inventory: camera-angle guidance, automatic video splitting, regression documentation, and presentation work remain visible as follow-ups
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_conflict_handl: not tested as a handoff package property
components.package_level_recipient_acknowledgment: the customer accepts product usefulness and operation, not one identified package and entry inventory
components.successor_operation_from_package_state: the customer independently uploads two videos and reads updated progress using written guidance without live step-by-step direction
components.independent_verification: the transcript is participant-generated and the PR status review is not an independent package audit

positive_findings: The recipient performs a real product operation rather than merely accepting a role or attending a transition meeting.
The operation is observed in a consented transcript and includes two sequential uploads plus result and chart verification.
The recipient states that the product works and has no product questions at the end of the session.
Known limitations and post-course support expectations remain visible rather than being erased by acceptance.
known_review_findings: The transition relies on repository documentation and written guidance without one package-level receipt.
The team remains available after the operation, so hidden predecessor dependence is not excluded.
API-key creation and server maintenance are described prospectively rather than transferred and acknowledged as current authority state.
falsifiers: the customer operation did not occur independently of live step-by-step direction
the transcript does not preserve the claimed two-upload result sequence
a versioned package and package-level recipient acknowledgment are located
account, credential, server, backup, and operational authority are shown to have transferred completely
the customer operates after predecessor support is unavailable

next_action: Seek one public transition where the same identified package joins package integrity, outgoing and incoming authority, credentials and dependencies, open decisions, rollback and conflict handling, package-level recipient acknowledgment, successor operation without hidden predecessor state, and genuinely independent review. Do not assemble a completion claim from different controls.
